leadText: Team Kings (Japanese: Kings-dan, literally Kings Gang) is a villainous team based in the Alola region. It appears in the Pokémon Horizon , which is loosely based on . Their design may have been inspired by Team Skull and the Aether Foundation, both of which appeared in the games.
